title: T1.1: Display "Default" for untyped stories + reserve "default" slug

text: Acceptance: (1) src/output.rs:342 fallback changed from "-" to "Default" — story show prints type: Default for untyped stories. (2) src/output.rs:256-259 list view renders [Default] badge for story_type == None. (3) src/storage.rs add_type rejects slug "default" (case-insensitive) with AppError::Validation. (4) Update tests: story_types.rs and story_import.rs to assert "Default". (5) New test: type_add_rejects_reserved_default_slug. (6) No use of storage or types.toml added to output.rs.
